Access tiers

Tier 8+ may move any load at any time.

Tiers 6 and 7 may work outside inspection hours with crates not declared fragile by the inspector.

Tiers 4 and 5 may work outside of inspection hours with non-fragile crates on shelves that also contain their label(s) or with written permission.
cases.claim: Access rules allow tiers 8+ to move any load at any time, tiers 6-7 to work outside inspection hours with non-fragile crates, and tiers 4-5 to work outside inspection hours with non-fragile crates on shelves containing their labels or with written permission.
